messages.subject: Deposit funds for exchange
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Following board sign-off next week, please confirm the amount and timing for the deposit and your client account details so treasury can pre-position the funds. We have the £1,850,000 ready in the acquisition account.

Thanks,
Rebecca Stone
Finance Director, Thornbury Properties Limited

messages.subject: RE: Deposit funds for exchange
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Rebecca,

The deposit is £1,850,000 (10%), payable to Marlowe Greaves as stakeholder on exchange. Please send it to our client account the day before exchange and we'll forward on completion of the call. For security we'll confirm our bank details by telephone – please don't act on any account details sent by email. I'll call you to verify before we request the funds.

James Osei
Senior Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
